title: Online therapeutic groups: integrative literature review (2012-2022)
quote: The findings highlight the diversity of approaches in understanding, grounding, and developing online group therapies. These care strategies have shown promise, particularly when in-person sessions are unfeasible.
summary: Revisão integrativa de 34 artigos (2012 a 2022) sobre grupos terapêuticos online, síncronos e híbridos: as estratégias mostraram potencial, sobretudo quando o presencial é inviável.
